claims.quote: Type locality is given as 'Lamag, Kinabatangan District, East Coast Residency, Malaysia', which corresponds to Kinabatangan district in modern-day Sandakan Division, Sabah state, Malaysia (northeastern Borneo).
The populations in Singapore are not thought to be natural and some probably escaped from commerical breeding facilities while others may have been introduced with intent.
The full extent of its range is unclear but similar-looking fish have been recorded in Indonesian (Kalimantan, Borneo), Singapore, Peninsular Malaysia (Muar), and Thailand (Bangkok).
